taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Maakoro-street (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 168 | 1.71 | 1.71
2 | 484 | 7.45 | 9.16
3 | 255 | 15.3 | 24.4
4 | 1109 | 25 | 49.4
5 | 807 | 74.2 | 124
6 | 8895 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as KHKH-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Maakoro-street (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: KHKH
Aquifer depth: 24.4 m – 124 m (Layers 4 and 5, ρ = 1109 Ω·m and 807 Ω·m)
Recommendation: Drill to approximately 125 m, casing off the low-resistivity clayey overburden (0–24.4 m) and screening the resistive sandy intervals between 24.4–49.4 m and especially 49.4–124 m, as the latter represents the thickest and most promising water-bearing zone before the highly resistive basement/bedrock is encountered below 124 m.
